entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call is important to us. Please hold for the next available agent.
This is unbelievable. I've been on hold for ten minutes! I want to return these useless shoes right now!
Hello, thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Sarah. I'm sorry about the wait. I can certainly look into a return for you. May I have your name and order number?
David Miller. Order number 7-8-6-5-5-0-4. And you better look into it fast. I bought these expensive cycling shoes two months ago and they're complete garbage.

Thank you, Mr. Miller. I'm pulling up your order now... I see the Mountain Bike Shoes, delivered 59 days ago. To make sure I understand fully, what specifically is the issue with them? Is it a technical fault or a matter of preference?

The issue is they've given me horrible blisters! They're torture devices, not shoes! I've tried adjusting the cleats, I've tried different socks, everything! I spend thousands of dollars with VeloFit every year, and this is the trash you send me? I want a full refund, and I want it now. This is completely unacceptable.
I am so sorry to hear about the discomfort and the blisters, Mr. Miller. That is absolutely not the experience we want for our customers, especially for a loyal VIP member such as yourself.

Don't give me that 'valued customer' speech. If you valued me, you'd solve my problem. Process the return or get me your manager right now. I am one click away from posting a review on every cycling forum that will make sure no one ever buys from you again!

I understand your frustration, and there's no need to speak with a manager, sir. I can absolutely handle this for you. Let me just confirm the return eligibility in our system... Okay, I see here that our standard return policy is 10 days from the delivery date.
So? It's been nearly 60 days. What does that mean?
It means you are well within the window for a return, Mr. Miller. I can approve this for a full refund right now. There's no problem at all.
Wait, really? You're just... approving it? No fight?

Yes, of course. I've just processed the authorization. You'll receive an email with a prepaid shipping label in the next few minutes. Once we receive the cycling shoes back at our warehouse, we'll issue the refund to your original payment method.

And Mr. Miller, as a sincere apology for the trouble and as a thank you for your long-term business with us, I've also added a $50 goodwill credit to your VeloFit account. You can use that on any future purchase.
Oh. A credit, too? Well... okay. That's... better than I expected. Fine. Just make sure that return label actually shows up.
I've just confirmed it was sent, so it should be in your inbox. We appreciate you giving us the chance to make this right. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a much better day.
